meaning:
Γαδαρηνός, -ή, -όν
(Γαδαρά, Gadara, the capital of Peræa),
Gadarene, of Gadara: Mat.8:28 (Rec. Γεργεσηνῶν), Mrk.5:1, Rec. (Edd., Γερασηνῶν), Luk.8:26, 37 Rec. (Edd., Γερασηνῶν).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: When he came to the other side, into the country of the Gergesenes, two people possessed by demons met him there, coming out of the tombs, exceedingly fierce…
